title: Echo a Ɛfa Abotan So
intro: Fa no sɛ bon bi a wɔatwitwa atrae afi abotan so, na mframa no de kɔkɔbɔ bi a wontie ho nkae kɔ. Bere bi na nkurɔfo bi dii yiye wɔ ha, a wɔahyira wɔn nanso wɔyɛɛ asoɔden, kosii sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne bi puei fii ɔbotan ankasa a na wɔwɔ ahotoso no mu.
clues: Ná yɛyɛ nkurɔfo a yedidwene afie a ahobammɔ wom fi mmepɔw so, na yɛte nka sɛ yɛwɔ ahobammɔ wɔ yɛn atrae a abotan wɔ so no mu.
Yɛte asase a asasetaw ne aboɔ so, a nturo ne nsuten ahyira so.
Ɔbɔfo bi fi yɛn mu bae, na ɔfrɛɛ yɛn sɛ yennyae yɛn atoro anyame no na yɛnsom nokware Ɔbɔadeɛ Baako no.
Yɛde ahantan de tebea bi sii hɔ ma gyidi: sɛnkyerɛnne soronko bi a ebepue afi abotan a yedi adwini no ankasa mu.
Bere a yoma ba a wɔhyɛɛ ho bɔ no fii ɔbotan no so puei, sɛnkyerɛnne a emu da hɔ no, yɛn nnipa atitiriw no da so ara powee na wɔbɔɔ no akuturuku ɛmfa ho kɔkɔbɔ a ɛfa ɔsɛe bi a ɛreba ho no.
Yɛn adeyɛ no akyi nnansa no, aprannaa bi bɔɔ wɔ bon no mu, na wɔtew yɛn so bɛyɛɛ amamfõ a ahwe ase, yɛn afie yɛ yɛn adamoa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
